title: Enigma 1 Machine made by Claude xhigh/low
author: 314t
selftext:
An Opus5.5 Agent on Xhigh gathered reference images and wrote a detailed specification, then did a handoff to an Opus 5.5 Low agent to create the Blender Model. Not 100% accurate, but pretty close. Video rendered from Blender.

## Time and tokens

| Stage | Model and effort | Time | Tokens in | New | Out |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Research | Opus 5.5 xhigh | 94 min | 18.71 M | 1.47 M | 297 k |
| Build | Opus 5.5 low | 67 min | 9.04 M | 0.35 M | 140 k |
| Photo check, 42 critic sessions | Opus 5.5 low | 29 min, inside the build | 5.37 M | 3.39 M | 123 k |
| Showcase video | Opus 5.5 low, same agent as the build | 80 min | 3.61 M | 0.07 M | 17 k |
| Coordinator, so far | Opus 5.5 | whole job | 10.71 M | 1.02 M | 87 k |
| **Total** | | | **47.44 M** | **6.30 M** | **664 k** |

What do you think?

comments.author: Original-League-6094
comments.body: It locks great. Did you specify 5.5 low or did it decide that on its own?

replies.author: 314t
replies.body: I specified low, goal was least cost/tokens with highest quality. I did three series of 3 rounds each to test best token vs quality, and this achieved the best balance, let another model do the thinking, and another model do the building. Still refining the workflow, will be trying something like Sonnet High, and maybe a haiku low or medium, just trial and error honestly.

comments.author: joaocamu
comments.body: That how i am running my game project and i found it to be the Best method. A bigger effort opus guiding opus lows and haikus xhighs
